sources.fullCitation: 1000 Takte-Tanz, Band 2: 22 der populärsten Tanz- und Gesangs-Schlager. Berlin: Alrobi-Musikverlag, 1929. Piano-vocal score; “Wenn wir nicht beide in Gesellschaft wären, würde ich dir Liebe schwören (Vergißmeinnicht),” music by Bronisław Kaper and words by Fritz Rotter, appears on p. 12. Alfred Grunwald Papers, *T-Mss 1998-030, series IV, box 17, folder 1, Billy Rose Theatre Division, The New York Public Library for the Performing Arts.

sources.researchNote: The volume was previously dated here to about 1939. Contemporary trade evidence places Band 2 in 1929. The NYPL finding aid documents a physical piano-vocal copy in box 17, folder 1; SRC0787 remains the separate Deutsches Lied index record for the song and its page-level metadata.
